{{Quote|The peko peko egg omelet is very good here, and they have fresh brul juice.''"<br />"''That sounds lovely.|Ivaar Workan and [[Abeloth]]|<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>}}
The '''peko peko egg omelet''' was served at [[The Nook]], a small, fashionable [[Restaurant/Legends|breakfast diner]] near the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Peko-peko/Legends|peko peko]] [[Omelette/Legends|omelet]] was enjoyed by [[Ivaar Workan]], a [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] posing as [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Kameron Suldar.<ref name="Ascension" />
